Wenn du ein Gerät (iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch oder Mac), auf dem „Wo ist?“ aktiviert ist, verlierst oder verlegst, kannst du es mit der Option „Wo ist?“ auf einer Karte orten. Darüber hinaus ermöglicht es „Wo ist?“, auf dem gesuchten Gerät einen Ton abzuspielen, das Gerät per Fernzugriff zu sperren und eine Meldung anzuzeigen oder es per Fernzugriff zu löschen. „Wo ist?“ kann dir ebenfalls dabei helfen, unterstütztes Zubehör zu orten oder einen Ton darauf abzuspielen.

Wenn du dich bei deinem Gerät anmeldest und iCloud aktivierst, werden bestimmte Funktionen von „Wo ist?“ automatisch aktiviert. Hierzu gehört die Teilnahme am „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk, einem Crowdsourcing-Netzwerk von Apple-Geräten, über das sich verlorene Geräte oder kompatible Objekte (wie unten beschrieben) lokalisieren lassen, und die Möglichkeit, einen Ton auf dem Gerät abzuspielen, es per Fernzugriff zu sperren und eine Meldung darauf anzuzeigen oder es per Fernzugriff zu löschen. Du wirst außerdem benachrichtigt, wenn du dich von deinen unterstützten Geräten und Objekten entfernst. iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch und bestimmte Macs sind durch die Aktivierungssperre geschützt und können ohne dein Passwort weder gelöscht noch erneut aktiviert werden. Weitere Informationen findest du unter support.apple.com/108794 oder support.apple.com/102541. Wenn du „Wo ist?“ auf deinem iPhone aktivierst, wird die Option automatisch auf jeder gekoppelten Apple Watch aktiviert. Du kannst „Wo ist?“ auch separat für eine Apple Watch aktivieren, wodurch die Option auf dem gekoppelten iPhone ebenfalls aktiviert wird.

Wenn die Ortungsdienste aktiviert sind, kannst du festlegen, dass deine aktuellen Standortdaten mit „Standort teilen“ geteilt werden. Wenn du und die andere Person beide iOS 17 nutzt, kann Apple nicht auf deinen Standort zugreifen. Falls du bereits mit einer Person teilst, die nicht iOS 17 installiert hat, kann Apple möglicherweise auf deinen Standort zugreifen, sofern er aktiv von einer befreundeten Person, mit der du teilst, angefordert wird. Dein Standort wird bis zu 24 Stunden gespeichert, um den Dienst bereitzustellen. Danach wird er gelöscht.

Die App „Wo ist?“ kann dir helfen, deine Geräte auf einer Karte zu orten, wenn du die Ortungsdienste aktiviert hast. Wenn du die Option „Letzten Standort senden“ aktiviert hast, wird der letzte bekannte Standort deines Geräts jedes Mal automatisch an Apple gesendet, wenn die Batterie des Geräts nahezu entladen ist.

„Wo ist?“ kann das „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk verwenden, um Geräte auch dann zu finden, wenn sie nicht mit dem Internet verbunden sind und sogar wenn sie ausgeschaltet oder gelöscht wurden (nur bei unterstützten Geräten). Geräte im „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk verwenden drahtlose Bluetooth-Technologie, um vermisste Geräte oder kompatible Objekte in der Nähe zu finden (einschließlich AirTags und mit deinem Apple Account registrierte kompatible Produkte von Drittanbietern) und ihren ungefähren Standort Eigentümer:innen zu melden. Wenn ein Gerät ausgeschaltet oder gelöscht wurde, ist der Standort auch für Mitglieder der Familienfreigabegruppe des:der Eigentümer:in sichtbar, mit denen der Standort geteilt wurde. Die Interaktion ist Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselt. Apple kann den Standort von Offline-Geräten oder meldenden Geräten nicht sehen. Wenn dein Gerät am „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk teilnimmt, kann es vom Netzwerk gefunden werden und anonym dabei helfen, andere Geräte zu finden. Du kannst die Teilnahme deines iOS- oder iPadOS-Geräts am „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk deaktivieren, indem du „Einstellungen“ > „[dein Name]“ > „Wo ist?“ > „Mein [Gerät] suchen“ auswählst und das „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk durch Tippen deaktivierst. Du kannst die Teilnahme deines Mac am „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk deaktivieren, indem du „Systemeinstellungen“ > „[dein Name]“ > „iCloud“ auswählst, auf „Meinen Mac suchen“ klickst und neben dem „Wo ist?“-Netzwerk auf „Aus“ klickst. Weitere Informationen zu AirTags und kompatiblen Produkten von Drittanbietern, einschließlich Anleitungen zum Hinzufügen dieser Produkte zu „Wo ist?“ und zu ihrer Registrierung mit deinem Apple Account, findest du unter support.apple.com/101602.

Du kannst „Wo ist?“ und die Aktivierungssperre auf deinem iOS- oder iPadOS-Gerät ausschalten. Öffne dazu „Einstellungen“ > „[dein Name]“ > „Wo ist?“ > „Mein [Gerät] suchen“ und deaktiviere „Mein iPhone suchen“ oder „Mein iPad suchen“. Auf dem Mac öffnest du „Systemeinstellungen“ > „[dein Name]“ > „iCloud“ und deaktivierst „Meinen Mac suchen“.

Wenn du festgelegt hast, dass du benachrichtigt werden möchtest, wenn du dich von deinen unterstützten Geräten und Objekten entfernst, schlägt dir das Gerät Orte vor, an denen du keine Mitteilungen erhältst, wie z. B. in deinem Zuhause oder auf der Arbeit. Diese Orte werden auf eine Art und Weise gesichert, die Apple nicht lesen kann. Du kannst in der App „Wo ist?“ auf deinem iOS- oder iPadOS-Gerät auch die Mitteilungen beim Zurücklassen deaktivieren. Tippe hierzu auf „Geräte“ oder „Objekte“, auf das entsprechende Gerät oder Objekt, auf „Beim Zurücklassen benachrichtigen“ und deaktiviere dann die Option „Beim Zurücklassen benachrichtigen“. Klicke in der App „Wo ist?“ auf dem Mac auf „Geräte“ oder „Objekte“, wähle ein Gerät oder Objekt aus, klicke auf die zugehörige Infotaste und deaktiviere dann die Option „Beim Zurücklassen benachrichtigen“.

If you lose or misplace your Find My–enabled iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch or Mac, Find My allows you to locate your device on a map. In addition, Find My allows you to play a sound on, remotely lock and display a message on, or remotely wipe the device you’re trying to find. Find My can also help you locate or play a sound on supported accessories.

When you sign in and enable iCloud on your device, certain features of Find My are enabled automatically. These include participation in the Find My network, a crowdsourced network of Apple devices that helps find missing devices or compatible items as described below, and the ability to play a sound on your device, remotely lock and display a message on it, or remotely erase it. You also will receive notifications if you are separated from your supported devices and items. Your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch and certain Mac computers will be protected with Activation Lock, and cannot be erased and reactivated without your password. For more information, visit support.apple.com/108794 or support.apple.com/102541. Enabling Find My on your iPhone will automatically enable it on any paired Apple Watch. You can also separately enable Find My for an Apple Watch, which will enable it on your paired iPhone.

When you have Location Services enabled, you can choose to share your device’s current location using Share My Location. If you and your friend are both on iOS 17, your location will not be accessible to Apple. If you have a pre-existing sharing relationship with a friend who is not on iOS 17, your location may be accessible to Apple if it is actively requested by a friend you are sharing with. Your location is retained for up to 24 hours in order to provide the service, after which it is deleted.

Find My can help you locate your devices on a map if you have enabled Location Services. If you choose to enable the Send Last Location feature, your device’s last known location will be automatically sent to Apple anytime your device’s battery reaches a critically low level.

Find My can use the Find My network to help find devices even if they are not connected to the internet and, for supported devices, even if they are turned off or erased. Devices in the Find My network use Bluetooth wireless technology to detect missing devices or compatible items nearby, including AirTags and compatible third-party products registered to your Apple Account, and report their approximate location back to the owner. If a device is turned off or erased, that location is also visible to members of the owner’s Family Sharing group with whom they have chosen to share the location. The interaction is end-to-end encrypted, and Apple cannot see the location of any offline device or reporting device. When your device participates in the Find My network, it can both be located by the network and anonymously help locate other missing devices. You can choose to have your iOS or iPadOS device not participate in the Find My network by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device] and tapping to disable Find My network. You can choose to have your Mac not participate in the Find My network by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud, clicking Find My Mac, then clicking Turn Off next to Find My network. For more information on AirTags and compatible third-party products, including instructions on adding these products to Find My and registering them to your Apple Account, visit support.apple.com/101602.

You can turn off Find My and Activation Lock on your iOS or iPadOS device by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device], and tapping to turn off Find My iPhone or Find My iPad, and on your Mac by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud and unselecting Find My Mac.

If you choose to receive notifications when you are separated from supported devices and items, your device will suggest locations where you will not receive notifications, such as your home or work. These locations are stored in a way that cannot be read by Apple. You can also turn off separation notifications in the Find My app on your iOS or iPadOS device by tapping Devices or Items, tapping a device or item, tapping Notify When Left Behind, then tapping to turn off Notify When Left Behind. In the Find My app on a Mac, click Devices or Items, select a device or item, click the Info button on the device or item, then turn off Notify When Left Behind.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

If you use Find My, we process personal data as necessary to provide the service and comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party, in order to:

• Provide you with the service
• Help to improve and optimise the service for you and others
• Prevent fraud and other malicious activity

The data used includes:

• Details about your account, including your Apple Account
• Information about your devices, including device version and location
• Your AirTags, AirPods and Find My network accessories, including the serial number
• The people you have shared with, if you choose to share the location of your device or personal item (including AirTags, AirPods and Find My network accessories)
• Your location, if either your device or your friend’s device is using an operating system earlier than iOS 17
• Your use of Find My, including when you connect AirTags, AirPods and Find My network accessories to your device

عند تمكين خدمات الموقع، يمكنك اختيار مشاركة الموقع الحالي لجهازك باستخدام "مشاركة موقعي". إذا كنت أنت وصديقك تستخدمان iOS 17، فلن تتمكن Apple من الوصول إلى الموقع. إذا كانت لديك علاقة مشاركة موجودة مسبقًا مع صديق لا يستخدم iOS 17، فقد تتمكن Apple من الوصول إلى موقعك إذا تم طلبه بوضوح من قبل صديق تشاركه معه. يتم الاحتفاظ بموقعك لمدة تصل إلى ٢٤ ساعة لتقديم الخدمة، وبعد ذلك يتم حذفها.

If you lose or misplace your Find My–enabled iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch, or Mac, Find My allows you to locate your device on a map. In addition, Find My allows you to play a sound on, remotely lock and display a message on, or remotely wipe the device you’re trying to find. Find My can also help you locate or play a sound on supported accessories.

When you sign in and enable iCloud on your device, certain features of Find My are enabled automatically. These include participation in the Find My network, a crowdsourced network of Apple devices that helps find missing devices or compatible items as described below, and the ability to play a sound on your device, remotely lock and display a message on it, or remotely erase it. You also will receive notifications if you are separated from your supported devices and items. Your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch, and certain Macs will be protected with Activation Lock, and cannot be erased and reactivated without your password. For more information, visit support.apple.com/108794 or support.apple.com/102541. Enabling Find My on your iPhone will automatically enable it on any paired Apple Watch. You can also separately enable Find My for an Apple Watch, which will enable it on your paired iPhone.

When you have Location Services enabled, you can choose to share your device’s current location using Share My Location. If you and your friend are both on iOS 17, your location will not be accessible to Apple. If you have a preexisting sharing relationship with a friend who is not on iOS 17, your location may be accessible to Apple if it is actively requested by a friend you are sharing with. Your location is retained for up to 24 hours in order to provide the service, after which it is deleted.

Find My can help you locate your devices on a map if you have enabled Location Services. If you choose to enable the Send Last Location feature, your device’s last known location will be automatically sent to Apple any time your device’s battery reaches a critically low level.

Find My can use the Find My network to help find devices even if they are not connected to the internet and, for supported devices, even if they are turned off or erased. Devices in the Find My network use Bluetooth wireless technology to detect missing devices or compatible items nearby, including AirTags and compatible third-party products registered to your Apple Account, and report their approximate location back to the owner. If a device is turned off or erased, that location is also visible to members of the owner’s Family Sharing group with whom they have chosen to share the location. The interaction is end-to-end encrypted, and Apple cannot see the location of any offline device or reporting device. When your device participates in the Find My network, it can both be located by the network and anonymously help locate other missing devices. You can choose to have your iOS or iPadOS device not participate in the Find My network by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device] and tapping to disable Find My network. You can choose to have your Mac not participate in the Find My network by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud, clicking Find My Mac, then clicking Turn Off next to Find My network. For more information on AirTags and compatible third-party products, including instructions on adding these products to Find My and registering them to your Apple Account, visit support.apple.com/101602.

You can turn off Find My and Activation Lock on your iOS or iPadOS device by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device], and tapping to turn off Find My iPhone or Find My iPad, and on your Mac by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud and deselecting Find My Mac.

If you choose to receive notifications when you are separated from supported devices and items, your device will suggest locations where you will not receive notifications, such as your home or work. These locations are stored in a way that cannot be read by Apple. You can also turn off separation notifications in the Find My app on your iOS or iPadOS device by tapping “Devices” or “Items,” tapping a device or item, tapping Notify When Left Behind, then tapping to turn off Notify When Left Behind. In the Find My app on a Mac, click “Devices” or “Items,” select a device or item, click the Info button on the device or item, then turn off Notify When Left Behind.

In addition, Find My allows you to play a sound on, remotely lock and display a message on, or remotely wipe the device you’re trying to find. Find My can also help you locate or play a sound on supported accessories.

When you sign in and enable iCloud on your device, certain features of Find My are enabled automatically. These include participation in the Find My network, a crowdsourced network of Apple devices that helps find missing devices or compatible items as described below, and the ability to play a sound on your device, remotely lock and display a message on it, or remotely erase it. You will also receive notifications if you are separated from your supported devices and items. Your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch and certain Mac computers will be protected with Activation Lock, and cannot be erased and reactivated without your password. For more information, visit support.apple.com/108794 or support.apple.com/102541. Enabling Find My on your iPhone will automatically enable it on any paired Apple Watch. You can also separately enable Find My for an Apple Watch, which will enable it on your paired iPhone.

When you have Location Services enabled, you can choose to share your device’s current location using Share My Location. If you and your friend are both on iOS 17, your location will not be accessible to Apple. If you have a pre-existing sharing relationship with a friend who is not on iOS 17, your location may be accessible to Apple if it is actively requested by a friend you are sharing with. Your location is retained for up to 24 hours in order to provide the service, after which it is deleted.

Find My can help you locate your devices on a map if you have enabled Location Services. If you choose to enable the Send Last Location feature, your device’s last known location will be automatically sent to Apple any time your device’s battery reaches a critically low level.

Find My can use the Find My network to help find devices even if they are not connected to the internet and, for supported devices, even if they are turned off or erased. Devices in the Find My network use Bluetooth wireless technology to detect missing devices or compatible items nearby, including AirTags and compatible third-party products registered to your Apple Account, and report their approximate location back to the owner. If a device is turned off or erased, that location is also visible to members of the owner’s Family Sharing group with whom they have chosen to share the location. The interaction is end-to-end encrypted, and Apple cannot see the location of any offline device or reporting device. When your device participates in the Find My network, it can both be located by the network and anonymously help locate other missing devices. You can choose to have your iOS or iPadOS device not participate in the Find My network by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device] and tapping to disable Find My network. You can choose to have your Mac not participate in the Find My network by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud, clicking Find My Mac, then clicking Turn Off next to Find My network. For more information on AirTags and compatible third-party products, including instructions for adding these products to Find My and registering them to your Apple Account, visit support.apple.com/101602.

You can turn off Find My and Activation Lock on your iOS or iPadOS device by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device], and tapping to turn off Find My iPhone or Find My iPad, and on your Mac by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud and deselecting Find My Mac.

If you choose to receive notifications when you are separated from supported devices and items, your device will suggest locations where you will not receive notifications, such as your home or work. These locations are stored in a way that cannot be read by Apple. You can also turn off separation notifications in the Find My app on your iOS or iPadOS device by tapping Devices or Items, tapping a device or item, tapping Notify When Left Behind, then tapping to turn off Notify When Left Behind. In the Find My app on a Mac, click Devices or Items, select a device or item, click the Info button on the device or item, then turn off Notify When Left Behind.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

If you use Find My, we process personal data as necessary to provide the service and comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party in order to:

• Provide you with the service
• Help to improve and optimise the service for you and others
• Prevent fraud and other malicious activity

The data used includes:

• Details about your account, including your Apple Account
• Information about your devices, including device version and location
• Your AirTags, AirPods and Find My network accessories, including the serial number
• The people you have shared with, if you choose to share the location of your device or personal item (including AirTag or AirPods, and Find My network accessories)
• Your location, if either your device or your friend’s device is using an operating system earlier than iOS 17
• Your use of Find My, including when you connect AirTags, AirPods and Find My network accessories to your device

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at apple.com/in/privacy

나의 찾기가 활성화된 iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch 또는 Mac을 분실한 경우, 나의 찾기를 사용하여 지도에서 기기를 찾을 수 있습니다. 또한, 나의 찾기를 사용하여 찾으려는 기기에서 사운드를 재생하거나 메시지를 표시하고, 기기를 원격으로 잠그거나 지울 수 있습니다. 나의 찾기를 사용하여 지원되는 액세서리를 찾거나 액세서리에서 사운드를 재생할 수도 있습니다.

사용자의 기기에서 iCloud 계정에 로그인하고 iCloud를 활성화하면 ‘나의 찾기’의 특정 기능이 자동으로 활성화됩니다. 이 기능에는 아래 설명된 것과 같이 잃어버린 기기 또는 호환되는 물품을 찾을 수 있는 Apple 기기의 크라우드소싱 네트워크인 ‘나의 찾기 네트워크’에 참여하고, 기기에서 사운드를 재생하거나 메시지를 표시하고, 기기를 원격으로 잠그거나 지우는 기능이 포함됩니다. 지원되는 기기와 물품이 사용자로부터 분리되는 경우에도 알림을 받습니다. iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch 및 일부 Mac은 활성화 잠금으로 보호되며 사용자의 암호가 없으면 기기를 지우거나 다시 활성화할 수 없습니다. 자세한 정보는 support.apple.com/108794 또는 support.apple.com/102541 사이트를 참조하십시오. iPhone에서 ‘나의 찾기’를 활성화하면 페어링된 모든 Apple Watch에서도 자동으로 활성화됩니다. 또한 Apple Watch에서 별도로 ‘나의 찾기’를 활성화할 수도 있으며, 이 경우 페어링된 iPhone에서도 활성화됩니다.

위치 서비스가 활성화되어 있으면 ‘나의 위치 공유’를 이용하여 기기의 현재 위치를 공유하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 사용자 및 사용자의 친구가 모두 iOS 17 버전을 사용하는 경우, Apple이 사용자의 위치에 접근할 수 없습니다. iOS 17 버전을 사용하지 않는 친구와 기존에 성립한 공유 관계가 있다면, 공유 대상인 친구의 적극적인 요청이 있는 경우 Apple이 사용자의 위치에 접근할 수도 있습니다. 사용자의 정보는 서비스 제공을 위해 최대 24시간 동안 보관된 후 삭제됩니다.

‘나의 찾기’는 위치 서비스를 활성화한 경우 지도에서 사용자의 기기를 찾을 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 마지막 위치 보내기 기능을 활성화하면 기기의 배터리 잔량이 거의 남아 있지 않을 때 마지막으로 파악한 기기의 위치가 자동으로 Apple에 전송됩니다.

‘나의 찾기’는 ‘나의 찾기 네트워크’를 사용하여 기기가 인터넷에 연결되어 있지 않아도 기기를 찾을 수 있도록 도와주며, 지원되는 기기인 경우 기기가 꺼져있거나 지워졌더라도 찾을 수 있습니다. 나의 찾기 네트워크에 참여하는 기기는 Bluetooth 무선 기술을 사용하여 AirTag 및 사용자의 Apple 계정에 등록된 호환되는 타사 제품 등의 잃어버린 기기 또는 호환되는 제품을 주변에서 찾고 대략적인 위치를 기기의 소유자에게 리포트합니다. 기기가 꺼져있거나 지워져 있는 경우 해당 위치는 기기의 소유자가 속한 가족 공유 그룹에서 위치를 공유하도록 선택한 구성원에게도 보입니다. 해당 상호 작용은 종단간 암호화되며 Apple은 오프라인 기기 또는 리포트하는 기기의 위치를 볼 수 없습니다. 사용자의 기기가 ‘나의 찾기 네트워크’에 참여하면 네트워크로 해당 기기를 찾거나 익명으로 다른 잃어버린 기기를 찾도록 도와줄 수도 있습니다. 사용자의 iOS 또는 iPadOS 기기가 나의 찾기 네트워크에 참여하지 않도록 하려면 설정 > [사용자 이름] > 나의 찾기 > 나의 [기기] 찾기로 이동하고 ‘나의 찾기 네트워크’를 탭하여 비활성화하십시오. 사용자의 Mac이 나의 찾기 네트워크에 참여하지 않도록 하려면 시스템 설정 > [사용자 이름] > iCloud로 이동하고 ‘나의 Mac 찾기‘를 클릭한 다음 ‘나의 찾기 네트워크’ 옆에 있는 ‘끔’을 클릭하십시오. AirTag 및 호환되는 타사 제품을 나의 찾기에 추가하고 사용자의 Apple 계정에 등록하는 방법에 대한 지침 등 제품에 관한 자세한 정보는 support.apple.com/101602 사이트를 참조하십시오.

Al iniciar sesión y activar iCloud en tu dispositivo, ciertas funciones de Encontrar se activan automáticamente. Si tienes activada la función Localización, puedes compartir la ubicación actual de tu dispositivo mediante Compartir mi ubicación. If you lose or misplace your Find My–enabled iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch or Mac, Find My allows you to locate your device on a map. In addition, Find My allows you to play a sound on, remotely lock and display a message on, or remotely wipe the device you’re trying to find. Find My can also help you locate or play a sound on supported accessories.

When you sign in and enable iCloud on your device, certain features of Find My are enabled automatically. These include participation in the Find My network, a crowdsourced network of Apple devices that helps find missing devices or compatible items as described below, and the ability to play a sound on your device, remotely lock and display a message on it, or remotely erase it. You will also receive notifications if you are separated from your supported devices and items. Your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch and certain Mac computers will be protected with Activation Lock, and cannot be erased and reactivated without your password. For more information, visit support.apple.com/108794 or support.apple.com/102541. Enabling Find My on your iPhone will automatically enable it on any paired Apple Watch. You can also separately enable Find My for an Apple Watch, which will enable it on your paired iPhone.

When you have Location Services enabled, you can choose to share your device’s current location using Share My Location. If you and your friend are both on iOS 17, your location will not be accessible to Apple. If you have a pre-existing sharing relationship with a friend who is not on iOS 17, your location may be accessible to Apple if it is actively requested by a friend you are sharing with. Your location is retained for up to 24 hours in order to provide the service, after which it is deleted.

Find My can help you locate your devices on a map if you have enabled Location Services. If you choose to enable the Send Last Location feature, your device’s last known location will be automatically sent to Apple any time your device’s battery reaches a critically low level.

Find My can use the Find My network to help find devices even if they are not connected to the internet and, for supported devices, even if they are turned off or erased. Devices in the Find My network use Bluetooth wireless technology to detect missing devices or compatible items nearby, including AirTags and compatible third-party products registered to your Apple Account, and report their approximate location back to the owner. If a device is turned off or erased, that location is also visible to members of the owner’s Family Sharing group with whom they have chosen to share the location. The interaction is end-to-end encrypted, and Apple cannot see the location of any offline device or reporting device. When your device participates in the Find My network, it can both be located by the network and anonymously help locate other missing devices. You can choose to have your iOS or iPadOS device not participate in the Find My network by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device] and tapping to disable Find My network. You can choose to have your Mac not participate in the Find My network by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud, clicking Find My Mac, then clicking Turn Off next to Find My network. For more information on AirTags and compatible third-party products, including instructions for adding these products to Find My and registering them to your Apple Account, visit support.apple.com/101602.

You can turn off Find My and Activation Lock on your iOS or iPadOS device by going to Settings > [your name] > Find My > Find My [device], and tapping to turn off Find My iPhone or Find My iPad, and on your Mac by going to System Settings > [your name] > iCloud and deselecting Find My Mac.

If you choose to receive notifications when you are separated from supported devices and items, your device will suggest locations where you will not receive notifications, such as your home or work. These locations are stored in a way that cannot be read by Apple. You can also turn off separation notifications in the Find My app on your iOS or iPadOS device by tapping Devices or Items, tapping a device or item, tapping Notify When Left Behind, then tapping to turn off Notify When Left Behind. In the Find My app on a Mac, click Devices or Items, select a device or item, click the Info button on the device or item, then turn off Notify When Left Behind.

Si votre position est déjà partagée avec un contact dont l’appareil n’exécute pas iOS 17, Apple peut accéder à votre position si ce contact demande activement à accéder à cette dernière. Pour en savoir plus sur les AirTags et sur les produits tiers compatibles, et pour obtenir des instructions afin d’ajouter ces produits à Localiser et de les associer à votre compte Apple, consultez la page suivante : support.apple.com/101602.

यदि आपका Find My सक्षम iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod touch या Mac खो जाता है या गुम हो जाता है, तो Find My आपको नक़्शे पर अपना डिवाइस ढूँढने की सुविधा देता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, Find My आपको ढूँढे जा रहे डिवाइस पर ध्वनि बजाने, उसे रिमोटली लॉक करने और उस पर संदेश प्रदर्शित करने या रिमोटली उसका डेटा मिटाने की सुविधा देता है। Find My से आपको समर्थित ऐक्सेसरी ढूँढने या उस पर ध्वनि बजाने में भी मदद मिल सकती है।

जब आप iCloud में साइन इन करते हैं और अपने डिवाइस पर उसे सक्षम करते हैं, तो Find My के कुछ फ़ीचर ऑटोमैटिकली सक्षम कर दिए जाते हैं। इनमें Find My नेटवर्क, जो कि Apple डिवाइस का क्राउडसोर्स नेटवर्क है जो नीचे दिए गए वर्णन के अनुसार गुम हुए डिवाइस या संगत आइटम ढूँढने में सहायता करता है, में सहभागिता और आपके डिवाइस पर ध्वनि चलाने, उसे रिमोटली लॉक करने और उस पर संदेश डिस्प्ले करने या उसका डेटा रिमोटली मिटाने की क्षमता शामिल होती है। अगर आप अपने समर्थित डिवाइस और आइटम से अलग होते हैं, तो आपको सूचनाएँ भी मिलेंगी। आपके iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Watch और कुछ विशेष Mac की सुरक्षा ऐक्टिवेशन लॉक से की जाएगी और इसे आपके पासवर्ड के बिना मिटाया और फिर से सक्रिय नहीं किया जा सकता है। अधिक जानकारी के लिए support.apple.com/108794 या support.apple.com/102541 पर जाएँ। आपके iPhone पर Find My को सक्षम करने से वह किसी भी पेयर्ड Apple Watch पर ऑटोमैटिकली सक्षम हो जाएगा। आप Apple Watch के लिए भी Find My को अलग से सक्षम कर सकते हैं, ताकि वह आपके पेयर्ड iPhone पर भी सक्षम हो जाए।

जब आप स्थान सेवा सक्षम करते हैं, तो आप “मेरा स्थान शेयर करें” का उपयोग करके अपने डिवाइस के मौजूदा स्थान को शेयर करने का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं। अगर आप और आपका दोस्त दोनों iOS 17 पर हैं, तो आपका स्थान Apple के लिए ऐक्सेस करने योग्य नहीं होगा। यदि आपका किसी दोस्त के साथ पहले से मौजूद शेयरिंग संबंध है जो iOS 17 पर नहीं है, तो आपका स्थान Apple के लिए ऐक्सेस करने योग्य हो सकता है यदि इसका अनुरोध ऐसे दोस्त द्वारा सक्रिय रूप से किया गया है जिससे आप स्थान शेयर कर रहे हैं। आपके स्थान की जानकारी 24 घंटे तक रिटेन की जाती है ताकि सेवा दी जा सके, जिसके बाद इसे डिलीट कर दिया जाता है।

अगर आपने स्थान सेवा को सक्षम किया है, तो Find My की मदद से आप अपने डिवाइस को नक़्शे पर देख सकते हैं। अगर आप अंतिम स्थान भेजें फ़ीचर को सक्षम करने का विकल्प चुनते हैं, तो आपके डिवाइस का अंतिम ज्ञात स्थान ऑटोमैटिकली Apple को भेजा जाएगा जब आपके डिवाइस की बैटरी अत्यंत निम्न स्तर पर पहुँच जाती है।

Find My नेटवर्क की मदद से Find My डिवाइस तब भी ढूँढने में मदद कर सकता है जब वे इंटरनेट से कनेक्टेड नहीं होते हैं और समर्थित डिवाइस को तब भी ढूँढा जा सकता है जब वे बंद होते हैं या उनका डेटा मिटा दिया जाता है। Find My नेटवर्क के डिवाइस, गुम हुए डिवाइस या AirTags और आपके Apple खाते के साथ पंजीकृत संगत तृतीय पक्ष के उत्पादों सहित आस-पास के संगत आइटम का पता लगाने के लिए Bluetooth वायरलेस टेक्नोलॉजी का उपयोग करते हैं और उनके अनुमानित स्थान की रिपोर्ट वापस ओनर को देते हैं। यदि कोई डिवाइस बंद किया जाता है या उसका डेटा मिटा दिया जाता है, तो वह स्थान ओनर के फ़ैमिली शेयरिंग समूह के उन सदस्यों को भी दिखाई देता है जिनके साथ उन्होंने स्थान शेयर करने का फ़ैसला किया है। इंटरऐक्शन एंड-टू-एंड एन्क्रिप्ट किया जाता है और Apple किसी भी ऑफ़लाइन डिवाइस या रिपोर्ट करने वाले डिवाइस का स्थान नहीं देख सकता है। जब आपका डिवाइस Find My नेटवर्क में सहभागी होता है, तो इसका नेटवर्क द्वारा भी पता लगाया जा सकता है और अन्य गुम डिवाइस को अनाम रहते हुए पता लगाने में मदद ली जा सकती है। अपने iOS या iPadOS डिवाइस को Find My नेटवर्क में सहभागिता करने से रोकने के लिए सेटिंग्ज़ > [आपका नाम] > Find My > “मेरा [डिवाइस] ढूँढें” पर जाएँ और Find My नेटवर्क को टैप करके अक्षम करें। आप सिस्टम सेटिंग्ज़ > [आपका नाम] > iCloud पर जाकर, मेरा Mac ढूँढें पर क्लिक करके, फिर Find My नेटवर्क के आगे बंद करें पर क्लिक करके अपने Mac को Find My नेटवर्क में भाग न लेने का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं। AirTags और संगत तृतीय पक्ष के उत्पादों के संबंध में अधिक जानकारी के साथ-साथ Find My में इन उत्पादों को जोड़ने और उन्हें अपने Apple खाते के साथ पंजीकृत करने संबंधी निर्देशों के लिए support.apple.com/101602 देखें।

आप अपने iOS या iPadOS डिवाइस पर सेटिंग्ज़ > [आपका नाम] > Find My > मेरा [डिवाइस] ढूँढें पर जाकर और “मेरा iPhone ढूँढें” या “मेरा iPad ढूँढें” को बंद करने के लिए टैप करके और अपने Mac पर सिस्टम सेटिंग्ज़ > [आपका नाम] > iCloud पर जाकर और “मेरा Mac ढूँढें” का चयन हटाकर Find My और ऐक्टिवेशन लॉक को बंद कर सकते हैं।

अगर आप समर्थित डिवाइस और आइटम से अलग होने पर सूचनाएँ पाने का चुनाव करते हैं, तो आपका डिवाइस उन स्थानों का सुझाव देगा जहाँ आपको सूचनाएँ नहीं मिलेंगी, जैसे आपका घर या कार्यस्थल। ये स्थान ऐसे स्टोर किए जाते हैं कि वे Apple द्वारा पढ़े नहीं जा सकते हैं। आप अपने iOS या iPadOS डिवाइस पर Find My ऐप में “डिवाइस” या “आइटम” पर टैप करके, किसी डिवाइस या आइटम पर टैप करके, “छूट जाने पर सूचित करें” पर टैप करके, फिर “छूट जाने पर सूचित करें” को बंद करने के लिए टैप करके भी अलग होने की सूचनाएँ बंद कर सकते हैं। Mac पर Find My ऐप में, “डिवाइस” या “आइटम” पर क्लिक करें, कोई डिवाइस या आइटम चुनें, डिवाइस या आइटम पर जानकारी बटन पर क्लिक करें, फिर “छूट जाने पर सूचित करें” को बंद करें।

अगर आप Find My का इस्तेमाल करते हैं, तो हम सेवा प्रदान करने और हमारी क़ानूनी बाध्यताओं का पालन करने के लिए व्यक्तिगत डेटा को प्रोसेस करते हैं। जहाँ सहमति उपयुक्त क़ानूनी आधार होती है, हम इसे लागू होने वाले स्थानीय क़ानून के अनुसार प्राप्त करने की कोशिश करते हैं।

जहाँ लागू होने वाले स्थानीय क़ानून निर्देशित करते हैं, हम अपने या तृतीय पक्ष के तर्कसंगत हितों के उद्देश्यों के लिए आवश्यकता के अनुसार व्यक्तिगत डेटा को प्रोसेस करते हैं ताकि :
